semiconductor_relevance: High — SEIWA OPTICAL CO., LTD. provides specialized optical solutions and equipment critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: SEIWA OPTICAL CO., LTD. specializes in providing optical solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include compact zoom lenses for LED Chip Sorter systems, high-precision microscopes for probe systems, and advanced mask aligners for MEMS and other applications. These products are integral to achieving high alignment accuracy and precision in semiconductor manufacturing.
